text:
Nina (People Ops): Quick heads-up: we're adding an explicit reassignment & LOA guidance thread for this cycle to avoid last-minute confusion.
Carlos (Eng Manager): Thank you. major pain point last cycle was juggling reviewers when people went OOO. Whats the official flow?
Nina (People Ops): Flow: 1) Manager emails people-ops@redwood.com with subject: "Review reassignment: <old reviewer> -> <new reviewer>". 2) We'll update the assignments CSV and re-run perms. 3) Confirmation posted back in the thread. Try to request 48h before the manager writeup deadline.
Lea (IC): If my reviewer changes mid-draft, will they still see my draft?
people-ops-bot: Permission note: drafts follow workspace permissions. After reassignment we sync access within ~15 minutes. New reviewer will see existing drafts.
Carlos (Eng Manager): LOA question: if someone is out during calibration, do we postpone their signoff?
Marta HR: If IC is on LOA before manager writeups, managers should submit a provisional note and flag "LOA" in the context field. HR will mark the case "pending calibration" and ensure final rating is only set after cohort sign-off or when employee returns, per policy.
Lea (IC): Who sees the LOA details? privacy concern.
Marta HR: Only HR and the manager see private LOA details. Accommodation specifics remain HR-only. Managers get a short summary: "Accommodations in place".
Nina (People Ops): Operational notes: we'll publish two CSVs: assignments_v1.csv and assignments_live.csv. Use assignments_v1 for planning; assignments_live is the source of truth.
Carlos (Eng Manager): Can we get a simple checklist for managers during writeups?
Nina (People Ops): Yes  Manager checklist: - confirm evidence links in context field - note cross-team contributions explicitly - flag LOA/accommodation if applicable - request reassignment via email if reviewer unavailable - sign off only after calibration window closes (if pending). We'll post as a short PDF.
Lea (IC): Small UI ask: can the form show reviewer name on the preview? sometimes i paste and forget whos assigned.
people-ops-bot: Product note: reviewer ID shown in header of the web form. Mobile view might not show it yet.
Marta HR: Extensions: managers can request via https://rwd.company/internal/review-extension with reason and proposed new date. Approvals aim within 24 business hours.
Carlos (Eng Manager): Thanks. i'll try to consolidate cross-functional evidence early.
Nina (People Ops): Action items: 1) People Ops: post manager checklist + CSVs by EOD Thu. 2) HR: drop LOA template + privacy notice. 3) Managers: submit reassignment requests 48h lead time when possible.
Lea (IC): Appreciate the clarity  helps reduce stress.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: draft window opens 72h before self-assess deadline.
Nina (People Ops): We'll run a 20min Q&A drop-in Friday 9:30am PT. Bring specific scenarios. Thanks! :sparkles:
